visualCharacteristics.purpose: Action tiles with title, text and one chevron CTA link; text-only tiles sit two per row, tiles with an image span the full width with the image on the right or behind the text
visualCharacteristics.description: White tiles with soft shadow and small radius: tile 1 full width with text left and photo right fading in from white; tiles 2-3 half width text only; tile 4 full width photo background with dark left gradient and white text. Bold sans title, body text, blue text link with chevron at the bottom.

contentPattern.structure: One row per tile, two cells. Text-only: (empty) | H2 title, paragraph, CTA link. Image right: H2 title, paragraph, CTA link | Image. Image background: Image | H2 title, paragraph, CTA link
contentPattern.description: Repeating look-alike tiles that wrap in a grid. Tile layout comes from the cells: no image gives a half-width text tile; an image cell after the body puts the image on the right; an image cell before the body fills the tile behind the text. The last link in the body is the CTA.
contentPattern.blockContent: Four action tiles: 'Symptom Checker' (image right), 'Clinical trials', 'Connect to support groups' (text only), 'The right answers, the first time' (background image)

usage.description: Action tiles with one CTA each; optional image on the right or as background.

reuseGuidance: Use for task/action tiles that each lead to one destination. One row per tile with a body cell (H2, paragraph, link) and an image cell: leave the image cell empty for a half-width text tile, put the image after the body for image-right, before the body for a background image.
